div.div: إِبِلٌ مَدْفَأَةٌ (As, Th, S, M, K) and ↓مُدَفَّأَةٌ (M, K) Camels having abundance of fur (As, Th, S, M, K) and fat; (As, S, K;) rendered warm by their fur; (M;) as also ↓ مُدْفِئَةٌ and ↓ مُدَفِّئَةٌ : (K:) or the latter two signify many camels; (As, S, M, O;) because (As, S, O) rendering one another warm by their breath; (As, S, M, O;) and so, accord. to the L, مُدْفَاةٌ, without ء. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
